# WinFormPy

A Python library that provides a Windows Forms-style API wrapper around Tkinter, enabling developers familiar with VB.NET/VB6 to build GUI applications using familiar patterns.

---

## Context

WinFormPy bridges the gap between Windows Forms (.NET) and Python by mapping WinForms controls, properties, and events to Tkinter. It provides:

- Familiar API for VB6/VB.NET developers migrating to Python
- Complete Windows Forms control set (Button, Label, Form, DataGridView, etc.)
- Event-driven programming with `.NET`-style handlers (`sender`, `EventArgs`)
- Dock/Anchor layout system for responsive UIs
- Modern WinUI 3 Fluent Design controls for Windows 11 styling
- Pre-built UI components (Chat, DataGrid, Email Client, Login, etc.)
- Application templates (IDE, File Explorer, Browser, MDI)

---

## Tech Stack

| Category | Technology | Version |
|----------|------------|---------|
| Language | Python | >= 3.10 |
| GUI Engine | Tkinter | Built-in |
| Build System | setuptools | >= 61.0 |
| Package Manager | uv (recommended) | Latest |
| Required Dependency | tkcalendar | >= 1.6.1 |
| Optional | Pillow | For ImageList/image processing |
| Optional | tkinterweb | For WebBrowser control |

---

## Project Structure

```
WinFormPy/
├── winformpy/
│   ├── winformpy.py           # Core library: controls, dialogs, enums, base classes
│   ├── winformpy_extended.py  # Extended controls (ConsoleTextBox, ExtendedLabel)
│   ├── winformpy_tools.py     # Utilities (FontManager, ColorManager, CSSManager)
│   ├── winui3.py              # WinUI 3 Fluent Design controls
│   ├── mauipy.py              # MAUI-style Shell/Pages
│   ├── mdipy.py               # MDI Parent/Child windows
│   ├── templates/             # Application boilerplates
│   │   ├── studio_template.py       # IDE-style (VS Code pattern)
│   │   ├── explorer_template.py     # Windows 11 File Explorer
│   │   ├── browser_template.py      # Tabbed web browser
│   │   ├── winui3_template.py       # WinUI 3 gallery
│   │   ├── navigation_pane_template.py
│   │   ├── navigation_rail_template.py
│   │   ├── maui_template.py
│   │   └── mdi_template.py
│   ├── themes/                # Theme files (WinUI3, Dark, Light)
│   └── ui_elements/           # Pre-built components
│       ├── chat/              # Messenger-style chat interface
│       ├── console/           # Terminal emulator
│       ├── data_grid/         # Tabular data with pagination
│       ├── db_connection/     # Database connection manager
│       ├── document_viewer/   # PDF/Word/Image viewer
│       ├── email_client/      # Complete email client
│       ├── login/             # Authentication forms
│       ├── master_detail/     # Master-detail layouts
│       ├── record_form/       # Auto-generated edit forms
│       ├── web_browser/       # Embedded browser
│       └── word_processor/    # Rich text editor
├── examples/                  # Runnable demos for all features
├── guides/                    # Documentation (Dock, Anchor, AutoSize, etc.)
├── tests/                     # Pytest test suite
│   ├── test_core.py           # Core classes, enums, value types
│   └── test_themes.py         # Theme configuration tests
├── pyproject.toml             # Project configuration
├── CHANGELOG.md               # Release history
├── CONTRIBUTING.md            # Contribution guidelines
├── CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md         # Community standards
└── README.md                  # Main documentation
```

## Configuration

### Installation

```bash
# Using uv (recommended)
git clone https://github.com/jrodriguezgar/WinFormPy.git
cd WinFormPy
uv sync

# From source
pip install -e .
```

### Optional Dependencies

```bash
pip install Pillow       # ImageList, image processing
pip install tkinterweb   # WebBrowser control
pip install tkcalendar   # Calendar controls (required)
```

---

## CLI Interface

No dedicated CLI. Run examples and templates directly:

```bash
# Run any example
uv run examples/<example_name>.py

# Run templates
uv run winformpy/templates/studio_template.py
uv run winformpy/templates/explorer_template.py

# Run UI element demos (Panel files have interactive demos)
uv run winformpy/ui_elements/data_grid/data_grid_panel.py
uv run winformpy/ui_elements/chat/chat_panel.py
```

## Functions & Public API

### Core Imports

```python
from winformpy import (
    # Application
    Application, Form, UserControl,
    
    # Controls
    Button, Label, LinkLabel, TextBox, RichTextBox,
    CheckBox, RadioButton, ComboBox, ListBox,
    Panel, GroupBox, TabControl, SplitContainer,
    DataGridView, ListView, TreeView,
    ProgressBar, TrackBar, NumericUpDown,
    PictureBox, ImageList, WebBrowser,
    
    # Menus & Toolbars
    MenuStrip, ToolStrip, StatusStrip, ContextMenuStrip,
    
    # Dialogs
    MessageBox, OpenFileDialog, SaveFileDialog,
    FolderBrowserDialog, ColorDialog, FontDialog,
    
    # Enums
    DockStyle, AnchorStyles, DialogResult,
    FormBorderStyle, FormStartPosition,
    
    # System
    SystemColors, SystemFonts, Clipboard, Font, FontStyle
)
```

### Extended Modules

```python
from winformpy.winformpy_extended import ExtendedLabel, ConsoleTextBox
from winformpy.winformpy_tools import FontManager, ColorManager, CSSManager, LayoutManager
from winformpy.winui3 import TextBlock, ToggleSwitch, InfoBar, NavigationView
from winformpy.mdipy import MDIParent, MDIChild
from winformpy.mauipy import Shell, ContentPage
```

### UI Elements (Pre-built Components)

```python
from winformpy.ui_elements.chat import ChatPanel, ChatManager, ChatBackend
from winformpy.ui_elements.data_grid import DataGridPanel, DataGridManager, ColumnDefinition, DataType
from winformpy.ui_elements.login import LoginPanel, LoginForm, LoginBackend
from winformpy.ui_elements.console import ConsolePanel, LocalConsoleIO
from winformpy.ui_elements.master_detail import MasterDetailPanel, MasterDetailBackend
from winformpy.ui_elements.record_form import RecordFormPanel, RecordFormDialog
from winformpy.ui_elements.web_browser import WebBrowserPanel
from winformpy.ui_elements.word_processor import WordProcessorPanel
from winformpy.ui_elements.document_viewer import DocumentViewerPanel
```

## Development Workflow

```bash
# Install dependencies
uv sync

# Run an example
uv run examples/basic_controls_example.py

# Run a template
uv run winformpy/templates/studio_template.py

# Run tests
uv run pytest tests/ -v

# Lint
uvx ruff check winformpy/
uvx ruff format winformpy/
```

## Technical Rules & Conventions

### Naming Conventions

| Element | Convention | Example |
|---------|------------|---------|
| Classes | PascalCase | `Form`, `DataGridView` |
| Properties | PascalCase | `Text`, `BackColor`, `Width` |
| Methods | PascalCase | `Show()`, `ApplyLayout()` |
| Events | PascalCase | `Click`, `TextChanged` |
| Private members | _underscore_prefix | `_tk_widget`, `_apply_dock` |
| Local variables | snake_case | `button_width`, `y_pos` |
| Constants | UPPER_SNAKE_CASE | `PADDING`, `SPACING` |

### Critical Layout Rules

1. **Always call `form.ApplyLayout()` BEFORE adding child controls**
2. **Dock order matters**: Top → Left/Right → Fill (last)
3. **Use DockStyle enums**, not strings: `DockStyle.Fill`, not `'Fill'`
4. **Track y_pos/x_pos** when positioning controls manually
5. **Controls MUST NEVER overlap** - use calculated positions

### Event Pattern

```python
# All event handlers receive (sender, EventArgs)
button.Click = lambda sender, e: handle_click(sender)
form.FormClosing = self.on_closing

def on_closing(self, sender, e):
    e.Cancel = True  # Prevent closing
```

### Control Initialization Order (Critical for Dock)

In `__init__` methods:
1. Create widget
2. Call `_auto_register_with_parent()`
3. THEN apply Dock/Anchor properties

### Container Frame Pattern

Controls with scrollbars use `_container_frame`:
```python
widget_to_place = ctrl._tk_widget
if hasattr(ctrl, '_container_frame') and ctrl._container_frame:
    widget_to_place = ctrl._container_frame
```

### UI Elements Architecture

All UI Elements follow three-layer separation:
- **UI Layer** (Panel/Form): Visual components
- **Manager Layer**: Business logic and state
- **Backend Layer**: External implementation (provided by user)

---

## Key Entry Points

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `winformpy/winformpy.py` | Core controls, forms, dialogs, enums |
| `winformpy/winui3.py` | WinUI 3 Fluent Design controls |
| `winformpy/winformpy_tools.py` | Font, Color, CSS, Layout utilities |
| `winformpy/winformpy_extended.py` | Extended controls |
| `winformpy/templates/*.py` | Application boilerplates |
| `winformpy/ui_elements/*/` | Pre-built embeddable components |
| `examples/*.py` | Feature demonstrations |

---

## Quick Start Example

```python
from winformpy import Form, Button, Label, MessageBox, Application

class MyForm(Form):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.Text = "My App"
        self.Width = 400
        self.Height = 300
        self.StartPosition = "CenterScreen"
        
        self.label = Label(self)
        self.label.Text = "Hello, WinFormPy!"
        self.label.Left = 50
        self.label.Top = 50
        
        self.button = Button(self)
        self.button.Text = "Click Me"
        self.button.Left = 50
        self.button.Top = 100
        self.button.Click = self.on_click
    
    def on_click(self, sender, e):
        MessageBox.Show("Button clicked!", "Info")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    Application.Run(MyForm())
```
